topic: Implementing a Circuit Breaker pattern with atomic operations in Rust
principle: Use atomics for the hot path to avoid lock contention, but combine atomic reads with lock-guarded state carefully. When multiple pieces of state must be read atomically together, either use a single atomic, a lock for all reads, or accept eventual consistency with a clear fallback strategy. Reset all related state on success to avoid inconsistent views.
instruction: When building a circuit breaker that tracks failure counts and a last-failure timestamp across concurrent async tasks, prefer atomics for the counter (the frequently written/read path) and a lock only for the timestamp (rarely written). Ensure that the is_open check and the record_failure/record_success methods do not leave the circuit breaker in an inconsistent state where the counter and timestamp disagree.
